name: my-web-2026
description: my-web-2026 — Personal Web Platform on Cloudflare Workers with TanStack Start, Hono and Panda CSS.

scripts.deploy:production: pnpm run build && pnpm run deploy:production:prepared
scripts.cf-typegen:check: pnpm run cf-typegen && git diff --exit-code -- worker-configuration.d.ts
scripts.test: vitest run && node --test scripts/check-client-bundle.test.mjs && node --test scripts/infisical-bootstrap.test.mjs && node --test scripts/infisical-bootstrap-api.test.mjs && node --test scripts/infisical-bootstrap-cf.test.mjs && node --test scripts/infisical-seed.test.mjs && node --test scripts/infisical-verify.test.mjs && node --test scripts/deploy-with-secrets.test.mjs && node --test scripts/run-deploy-inner.test.mjs && node --test scripts/check-cf-secrets.test.mjs && node --test scripts/check-infisical-coverage.test.mjs && node --test scripts/bootstrap-home-api-key.test.mjs
scripts.validate:fast: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint:check && pnpm run architecture:check && pnpm run version:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run infisical:check:coverage && pnpm run test
scripts.validate:integration: pnpm run validate:fast && pnpm run build && pnpm run wrangler:dry-run && pnpm run wrangler:production:dry-run && pnpm run lint:ci && pnpm run build-storybook
scripts.validate:release: pnpm run validate:integration && pnpm run cf-typegen:check
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply my-web-2026 --remote -c wrangler.production.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:list:production: wrangler d1 migrations list my-web-2026 --remote -c wrangler.production.jsonc
